description: This Java source file implements an HTTP session listener for the Apache OFBiz framework which tracks session creation and destruction, manages session-related data such as visit info and user login info, and logs session statistics.

classes.name: ControlEventListener
classes.description: Implements HttpSessionListener to handle session lifecycle events, maintain session statistics, and persist session-related data.

methods.name: sessionCreated
methods.description: Handles logic when a new session is created; increments session count and sets logging attributes.

methods.name: sessionDestroyed
methods.description: Handles cleanup and data persistence when a session is destroyed; updates visit info, user login data, and logs session statistics.

methods.name: logStats
methods.description: Logs detailed statistics about the session and associated visit data.

methods.name: getTotalActiveSessions
methods.description: Returns total count of active sessions.

methods.name: getTotalPassiveSessions
methods.description: Returns total count of passive (passivated) sessions.

methods.name: getTotalSessions
methods.description: Returns total count of sessions (active + passive).

methods.name: countPassivateSession
methods.description: Moves a session from active to passive count.

methods.name: countActivateSession
methods.description: Moves a session from passive to active count.

methods.name: getUserLoginSession
methods.description: Serializes the user login session data into an XML string.
